images.title: Numbers on a number line
images.purpose: Show 8,640, 19,780, 24,305 and 31,250 placed on a number line from 0 to 40,000 so that the order from left to right is the increasing order.
images.composition: A number line with 5 equal marks in the lower half, 4 number cards above it joined to their places by leader lines, and an arrow below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A horizontal thick dark number line with plain ends, from x = 160 to x = 1296, at about y = 520. 5 tall tick marks equally spaced 284 px apart, at x = 160, 444, 728, 1012 and 1296, with the labels 0, 10,000, 20,000, 30,000, 40,000 under them in bold dark numerals (46 px). 4 number cards above the line, each a rounded rectangle about 190 by 80 px with a blue #0072B2 fill and white bold numerals (44 px), each joined by a thin vertical dark leader line to a filled reddish purple #CC79A7 dot on the line. Positions as a share of the line length from 0: 8,640 at 0.216 (x = 405, a little more than one fifth of the way); 19,780 at 0.495 (x = 722, just left of the 20,000 mark); 24,305 at 0.608 (x = 851, between 20,000 and 30,000, nearer 20,000); 31,250 at 0.781 (x = 1048, just right of the 30,000 mark). The cards of 19,780 and 31,250 sit on a higher tier (about y = 170) and the cards of 8,640 and 24,305 on a lower tier (about y = 300), so no card touches another. Under the tick labels a thin grey #6B7280 arrow pointing right from x = 160 to x = 1296 with the text Farther right is greater centred above it (40 px, dark).
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A number farther to the right on the number line is greater, so reading left to right gives the increasing order.
images.description: A number line from 0 to 40,000 with marks every 10,000 and four cards, 8,640, 19,780, 24,305 and 31,250, joined to their places, with an arrow marked Farther right is greater.
images.context: Concept image for Ordering numbers on a number line. It follows the number line with number cards in your maths book and uses the video's own example, 31,250, 8,640, 24,305 and 19,780.
images.teaching_notes: Place each number by finding the two marks it lies between. Read the cards from left to right: 8,640, 19,780, 24,305, 31,250. The cards are not on the line in the order they are told in the video, which is the point of the picture.

image_decisions.why: A number line with equal marks and placed cards shows order as position, left to right.
